title: माध्यमिक नेपाली भाषापाठ्यक्रमको समीक्षात्मक मूल्याङ्कन {Critical evaluation of secondary Nepali language course}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख माध्यमिक नेपाली भाषापाठ्यक्रमको समीक्षासँग सम्बन्धित रहेको छ । यस लेखमा पाठ्यक्रम विकास केन्द्रद्वारा वि. सं. २०७१ सालमा माध्यमिक तह कक्षा ९ र १० का लागि निर्मित नेपाली भाषापाठ्यक्रमको तत्वगत समीक्षा गरिएको छ । यस आलेखको उद्देश्य माध्यमिक नेपाली भाषापाठ्यक्रमको समीक्षण गर्नु, भाषापाठ्यक्रमको परिचय दिनु, अङ्गहरु तथा समीक्षाका आधारहरु निरुपण गर्नु, तत्वगत विवेचना गर्नु, सबल र दुर्वल पक्षहरु निरुपण गर्नु रहेका छन् । यसमा भाषापाठ्यक्रमका तत्व अन्तर्गत पाठ्यक्रमको परिचय, तहगत सक्षमता, कक्षागत सिकाइ उपलब्धि, विधाको क्षेत्र, क्रम तथा विस्तृतीकरण, सिकाई सहजीकरण प्रक्रिया र मूल्याङ्कन प्रक्रियाको चर्चा गरिएको छ । भाषापाठ्यक्रमलाई समयसापेक्ष बनाउने प्रयत्न गरिएको, पाठ्यक्रमलाई उपयोगी, प्रयोगात्मक र व्यावहारिक बनाइएको, भाषिक सक्षमतालाई महत्व दिइएको, सिपमा आधारित भई सिकाइ उपलब्धि निर्धारण गरिएको क्षमता अभिवृद्धि गर्न रचनामुखी विषयवस्तु राखिएको, विधा तथा पाठ्य विषयको छनोट र स्तरणगत उपयुक्ततामा पर्याप्त ध्यान दिइएको नस्ता निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: This paper is related to a review of the secondary Nepali language curriculum. In this paper, the curriculum developed by the Curriculum Development Centre for classes 9 and 10 in the year 2072 BS has been reviewed in terms of its elements. The purpose of this paper is to review the secondary Nepali language curriculum, to introduce the curriculum, to explain its components and the basis for review, to make an element-based analysis, and to identify its strengths and weaknesses. This paper has discussed the elements of the curriculum under the elements of the curriculum, such as the introduction to the curriculum, the proficiency levels, the achievement in the classroom, the areas of methods, the order and expansion of methods, the process of facilitation of teaching, and the process of evaluation. It has been concluded that efforts have been made to make the curriculum time-bound, the curriculum has been made useful, practical and experimental, linguistic proficiency has been emphasised, teaching has been made competency-based for achievement determination, cognitive elements have been placed to promote competency improvement, methods and course contents have been selected and stratified according to the level of suitability, and sufficient attention has not been paid to the process of evaluation.
british_english: This paper is connected to an examination of the secondary Nepali language curriculum. In this study, the curriculum established by the Curriculum Development Centre for grades 9 and 10 in the year 2072 BS is reviewed in terms of its constituent elements. The objectives of this paper are to assess the secondary Nepali language curriculum, introduce the curriculum, delineate its components and review criteria, conduct an element-based analysis, and identify its strong and weak points. The paper discusses the curriculum under various elements such as the curriculum introduction, proficiency levels, classroom achievement, method areas, method order and expansion, teaching facilitation process, and evaluation process. It has been concluded that efforts have been made to ensure the curriculum is time-sensitive, made it useful, practical and experimental, emphasised linguistic proficiency, made teaching competency-based for achievement determination, placed cognitive elements to promote competency improvement, selected and stratified methods and course contents according to suitability levels, and inadequate attention has been given to the evaluation process.
australian_english: This study relates to an examination of the secondary Nepali language curriculum. In this paper, the curriculum developed by the Curriculum Development Centre for classes 9 and 10 in the year 2072 BS has been reviewed based on its elements. The purpose of this study is to review the secondary Nepali language curriculum, introduce the curriculum, explain its components and review basis, make an element-based analysis, and identify its strengths and weaknesses. The paper discusses curriculum elements such as curriculum introduction, proficiency levels, classroom achievement, method areas, method sequence and expansion, teaching facilitation process, and evaluation process. It has been concluded that efforts have been made to make the curriculum time-bound, to make it useful, practical and experimental, to emphasise linguistic proficiency, to make teaching competency-based for achievement determination, to place cognitive elements to promote competency improvement, to select and stratify methods and course contents according to suitability levels, and inadequate attention has been given to the evaluation process.
informal_english: This paper looks at the secondary Nepali language curriculum. I reviewed the 2072 BS curriculum made by the Curriculum Development Centre for grades 9 and 10, focusing on its elements. The goals were to check out the curriculum, explain what it is, list its components and review criteria, do an element-based analysis, and find its strong and weak points. I talked about stuff like the curriculum intro, proficiency levels, classroom achievement, method areas, method order and expansion, teaching facilitation, and evaluation. Bottom line: they tried to make it time-sensitive, useful, practical, and experimental, focused on language skills, made teaching competency-based, added cognitive elements for improvement, chose and sorted methods and contents by suitability, but didn’t pay enough attention to evaluation.
